The other contribution uses negatives too.

The task isn't as challenging as it initially appears because the input is guaranteed to form an arithmetic progression. Therefore, the answer can always be found by simply subtracting the first number from the second. All remaining values are redundant and serve no purpose in solving the problem.

This makes the task essentially a single subtraction exercise rather than a problem that requires analysing the sequence or identifying its underlying pattern.

So, consider how the task could be refined to address these shortcomings while also making it more distinct from the quoted contribution.
